paper_description: Revealed that residual embryonic cells at the squamo-columnar junction are the cellular origin of Barrett's esophagus metaplasia, important for understanding esophageal adenocarcinoma.

Created an in vitro culture platform for adult intestinal stem cells and air-liquid interface organoids, enabling long-term self-renewal and differentiation, and successfully established a model for pseudomembranous colitis.
Created an efficient and stable 2D tumor cell line and 3D tumor organoid technology platform that captures tumor heterogeneity and can be used for drug screening and personalized medicine.

Systematically characterized metastatic seeds in primary colorectal cancer tissues, identified their organ-specific molecular mechanisms, and defined a set of marker genes for predicting metastatic risk.
